newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY O/N RATES RISE, FORINT SEEN EASING VS DLR.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY O/N RATES RISE, FORINT SEEN EASING VS DLR.

text.p: 0645 GMT - Hungary's overnight interest rates finished higher on Friday as liquidity tightened slightly on the first day of the two-week reserve period.
* The overnight rates finished at 19.875/20.125, compared with Thursday's 19.625/19.75 close.
* The forint was seen opening at the strongest point of the 4.5 pct wide central bank intervention band and remaining there today.
* The forint was expected to open easier against the dollar due to the mark's overnight weakening versus the U.S. unit.
* The forint/dollar was calculated at 197.23/28 at 0652 GMT, down from Thursday's clsoing 196.15/20.
